title: Put it together
idea: Review lesson: everything from Unit 1 mixed together, plus a tiny taste of writing a 2-line program.

exercises.prompt: Which instruction correctly shows the word Welcome?
exercises.explanation: Lowercase print, matching quotes, both brackets. All the rules at once.

exercises.prompt: A computer follows your instructions exactly, in order.
exercises.explanation: The core idea of the whole unit. Exactly, and in order.
Hello is text, so it needs quotes.
Opens with ( but never closes. Needs a ).

exercises.prompt: Build a correct instruction to show: Dailo rocks
exercises.explanation: The whole phrase in matching quotes, inside the brackets.

options: Hi then there on two lines

exercises.prompt: Which of these are fully correct? (pick all)
exercises.explanation: Text in quotes (ok) is fine; a bare number (7) is fine. A bare word fails; a missing ) fails.

exercises.prompt: Arrange a program that shows: Start, then a blank line, then Done.
exercises.explanation: Start, blank line, Done — in that order. Your first multi-line program!

exercises.prompt: Write a full, correct instruction to show the word: ready
exercises.explanation: print("ready") — you've got every rule down.

exercises.prompt: You can now make a computer do what?
options: Follow instructions in order and print messages
exercises.explanation: You finished Unit 1! You can give ordered instructions and print text and numbers. Next: remembering values so a later step can use them.
